emails.subject: student-success-committee@ — group membership confirmed
emails.body:
Hi Hannah,

Quick admin note — IT finished setting up the student-success-committee@halden.edu distribution list you asked for. Current members (5):

  • Dr. Hannah Lee (you) — Chair, Student Success Committee (Associate Director of Academic Advising)
  • Daniel Okafor — Senior Academic Adviser
  • Rosa Martinez — First-Year Success Program Coordinator / Adviser
  • Keiko Tanaka — Admissions Communications Manager (cross-functional partner, not in today's planning meeting)
  • Gregory Walsh (me) — Associate Dean of Student Success

Anything sent to that address will go to all five of us. Let me know if you want to add or remove anyone.

— Gregory

emails.subject: First-year retention initiative — fall budget confirmation
emails.body:
Hi Hannah,

Confirming the $185k fall envelope for the first-year retention initiative — the budget office has it locked in. After this morning's planning meeting, let me know how you're splitting it across platform / outreach comms / program spend so I can add it to the semester forecast.

Thanks,
Gregory

emails.subject: Loop me in on retention outreach comms
emails.body:
Hey Hannah,

Once you and Daniel settle the student-facing outreach timeline for the first-year retention initiative, could you loop me in? It overlaps with the admitted-student yield messaging I'm sending out this summer, and I want to make sure incoming students don't get conflicting emails from both of us.

No rush — happy to coordinate after your planning meeting this week.

— Keiko

emails.subject: Reminder: laptop refresh window opens May 5
emails.body:
Hi Hannah,

Your university laptop is approaching its 3-year refresh window. You can self-schedule a swap any time between May 5 and June 30 via the IT Services portal.

— Halden IT Services

emails.subject: Issue #312 — how mid-size universities are tackling first-year retention
emails.body:
Hi reader,
